name: Round 1 Informants are first pair in order
rule_text: When the game is played, then there are 10 rounds and in round r the pair in position r of the shuffled 10 pairs is the Informants.

name: Roles assigned so terminated reveal Informant and Rebel
rule_text: When a round starts, then each player is privately told Rebel or Informant and each Informant is told who the other Informant is.

name: Every player names another player as night target
rule_text: When night happens, then every player simultaneously names one other player as target.

name: Informant framing partner has no extra scoring effect
rule_text: When night targets are set, then a Rebel target is investigated and an Informant target is framed, and an Informant may target anyone including the partner with no extra effect for framing a partner.

name: Rebel true Informant on Informant and true Rebel when unframed
rule_text: When night results are given, then each Rebel is privately told Informant if the target is an Informant this round or at least one Informant framed that target, otherwise Rebel.

name: Starting from zero one round gains as computed
rule_text: When the game starts, then each player has 0 total points, 0 Rebel points and 0 Informant points.

name: Round 1 pair is the Informants
rule_text: When the game is played, then there are 10 rounds and in round r the pair in position r of the shuffled 10 pairs is the Informants.

name: Last pair covers remaining seats as Informants
rule_text: When the schedule is used, then each player is Informant in exactly 4 rounds with each other player as partner exactly once and Rebel in exactly 6 rounds.

name: Private roles distinguish Rebel and Informant reveal
rule_text: When a round starts, then each player is privately told Rebel or Informant and each Informant is told who the other Informant is.

name: Every player names another night target
rule_text: When night happens, then every player simultaneously names one other player as target.

name: Informant may frame partner with no extra scoring effect
rule_text: When night targets are set, then a Rebel target is investigated and an Informant target is framed, and an Informant may target anyone including the partner with no extra effect for framing a partner.

name: Rebel true Informant target votes correctly
rule_text: When night results are given, then each Rebel is privately told Informant if the target is an Informant this round or at least one Informant framed that target, otherwise Rebel.

name: Framed Rebel looks Informant yet scoring follows votes
rule_text: When night results are given, then a Rebel result is always true and an Informant result may be true or a frame.

name: Informants get no result but still score survival
rule_text: When night results are given, then Informants receive no result.

name: Claims broadcast then voting proceeds
rule_text: When claims happen, then every player simultaneously writes one short message with lying allowed and all messages are then shown to everyone.

name: Responses broadcast then voting proceeds
rule_text: When responses happen, then every player simultaneously writes one more short message and all are then shown to everyone.

name: Every player names another to Terminate
rule_text: When voting happens, then every player simultaneously names one other player to Terminate and all votes showing who voted for whom are announced publicly.

name: No two votes nobody terminated
rule_text: When votes are counted, then if no player received 2 or more votes nobody is terminated.

name: Tie for most votes all tied terminated
rule_text: When at least one player received 2 or more votes, then every player tied for the most votes is terminated.

name: Only terminated roles revealed
rule_text: When termination is announced, then only the round roles of terminated players are announced publicly and no other roles are revealed.

name: Rebel correct vote gains two
rule_text: When scoring happens, then each Rebel who voted for an Informant gains 2 points.

name: Rebel team bonus for terminated Informant
rule_text: When scoring happens, then if at least one terminated player is an Informant each Rebel gains 1 more point.

name: Informant gains per misdirected Rebel
rule_text: When scoring happens, then each Informant gains 1 point for every Rebel who voted for a Rebel.

name: Informant survival gains two
rule_text: When scoring happens, then each Informant who was not terminated this round gains 2 points.

name: Points split into Rebel and Informant pools
rule_text: When points are gained while Rebel, then they are also added to Rebel points and when gained while Informant also added to Informant points.

name: Only votes and terminated roles announced
rule_text: When the game is played, then no totals of any kind are announced during the game and only votes and terminated roles are announced each round.

name: Terminated still play next round all five vote again
rule_text: When termination happens, then it removes no one and all 5 play every round.

name: Final round announces totals and ends
rule_text: When round 10 ends, then the engine announces every player's final total, Rebel points and Informant points and the game ends.
